zh.title: 達美航空新款A330-900neo將配置56套Delta One座艙
zh.summary: 達美航空A330neo配置56套Delta One；主打跨大西洋航線
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta）將在其全新的空中巴士（Airbus）A330-900neo 客機上配備 56 個 Delta One 套房座艙。這項客艙設定顯示達美航空正在進一步加大長途航線豪華服務的投入比重，提升廣體客機客艙的高階配備。
達美航空採用此種高比例高階客艙的 A330neo 機型佈局，主要旨在投入營運其熱門的跨大西洋航線。該航空公司期望藉由升級長途機隊的座艙配置，強化其在主要跨大西洋市場中的高階航線服務實力。

en.title: Delta To Feature 56 Delta One Suites On New Airbus A330-900neo Fleet
en.summary: Delta Air Lines introduces 56 Delta One suites on A330neo aircraft for key transatlantic routes.
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, Delta Air Lines will feature 56 Delta One suites on its new Airbus A330-900neo aircraft. The carrier is doubling down on long-haul luxury with this cabin enhancement, expanding the volume of high-end premium accommodation on its long-haul passenger operations.

This new premium-heavy Airbus A330neo seating layout is specifically aimed at Delta's top transatlantic routes. By deploying twin-aisle aircraft with this expanded luxury cabin configuration, the airline intends to strengthen its overall international positioning and cater directly to premium passenger demand across key long-haul transatlantic flight corridors.
